items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: And Red and Dick both were playing in the Owls.

ctx.x: And Red and Dick both were playing in the Owls. And they used to come from New Orleans and go to DeLille and play dances. They had a pavilion there, a big dance pavilion. There was dance there every Saturday night. And they had a pretty fairly well-named band to play those dances. And it just packed.
